# Draft lifecycle and carry-forward in the daily note

The `## Drafts to review and send` section of the daily note carries unresolved drafts forward across daily note close and generation with a clear markdown shape and state representation (`draft`, `sent`, `discarded`, `carried-forward`) without introducing external networking dependencies or state-mutation APIs. Decided 06/08/2026.

**Context.** The `## Drafts to review and send` section of the daily note was previously un-carried during generation and lacked a defined markdown shape and state representation. Drafts generated by agents or EA assistants needed a clear lifecycle (`draft`, `sent`, `discarded`, `carried-forward`) and carry-forward behavior across daily note close and generation without introducing external networking dependencies or state-mutation APIs.

**Decision.**

1. **Draft shape**: In `## Drafts to review and send`, a draft is rendered as one task line with an explicit state tag and source wikilink, followed by indented sub-checkboxes following ADR-0036's keeper-options precedent:
   ```markdown
   - [ ] [draft] Follow up with Sam on pricing — [[Sam Patel]]
       - [ ] Send
       - [ ] Discard
       - [ ] Carry forward
   ```

2. **States & parsing**: States are exactly `draft`, `sent`, `discarded`, `carried-forward`. The state is derived from either checked sub-checkboxes (`- [x] Send`, `- [x] Discard`, `- [x] Carry forward`), a ticked top-level task checkbox (`- [x] [...]` means `sent`), or the header tag (`[draft]`, `[sent]`, `[discarded]`, `[carried-forward]`).

3. **Carry-forward & archiving**:
   - `close_daily_note` rewrites yesterday's unresolved `draft` items to `carried-forward` (`- [ ] [carried-forward] ...` and `- [x] Carry forward`) before moving the file to `archive/daily-notes/`, ensuring archived daily notes are faithful history.
   - Next day's `generate_daily_note` scans yesterday's archived note and copies unresolved drafts (`draft` or `carried-forward`) verbatim into the new day's `## Drafts to review and send` section as fresh `[carried-forward]` or `[draft]` items with clear sub-checkboxes (not into `## Today's tasks`).
   - `sent` and `discarded` drafts never carry forward.
   - Same-day refresh is additive-only, deduplicating on stable draft identity (wikilink).

4. **Review = docs only**: A "Review" subsection in `protocols/daily-note.md` specifies that review prompts carry no workflow state, link only to the Action Log `feedback:` field (`protocols/feedback-capture.md`), and never write that field. No code, no new protocol file, and no `## Review` section heading is added to the daily note schema.

5. **No external send**: Draft state changes are local markdown edits. The engine makes no network calls or subprocess invocations when drafts transition to `sent`.

**Consequences.**

- Daily note protocol is bumped to v6.
- Drafts persist faithfully across days until marked `sent` or `discarded`.
- Archived daily notes record exact historical status (`carried-forward`).
- System guarantees pure local markdown state preservation without external network side-effects.
